leaves.name: mumfordKLFiniteDivisorAC
leaves.doc: pic-fix2: for D an effective Cartier divisor (invertible ideal sheaf) on an abelian variety over an algebraically closed field with L = O(D) ample (IsAmple) and very ample (IsVeryAmple), K(L) is finite (Mumford, Abelian varieties, section 6 Application 1, (iv) => (ii); an instance of the print under either reading of Mumford's 'ample'; locator UNVERIFIED).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (Mumford 6 Application 1, D effective Cartier divisor, L = O(D) with IsAmple and IsVeryAmple, an instance under either reading of 'ample'); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Mumford, Abelian varieties, 6 Application 1: for D effective and L = O(D) ample, K(L) is finite

leaves.name: mumfordPhiSurjectiveVAC
leaves.doc: pic-fix2: for L ample (IsAmple) and very ample (IsVeryAmple) on an abelian variety X over an algebraically closed field, every translation-invariant class is t_x^*L (x) L^-1 for some x in X(k) (Mumford, Abelian varieties, section 8 Thm 1; an instance of the print under either reading of 'ample'; locator UNVERIFIED).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (Mumford 8 Thm 1 with IsAmple and IsVeryAmple, an instance under either reading of 'ample'); locator UNVERIFIED

leaves.name: amplePowVeryAmple
leaves.doc: pic-fix2: an ample class (IsAmple, Stacks 01PS) on an abelian variety over a field k has a power L^d, d >= 1, with an immersion i into P^N_k over k and L^d = i^*O(1) (Stacks, Morphisms, Lemma 29.39.4, Tag 01VU, (1) => (5); EGA II 4.5.10; Hartshorne II 7.6; locator UNVERIFIED).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (ample implies a power is very ample, X of finite type over Spec k; instance of the print for X an abelian variety); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Stacks Project, Morphisms, Lemma 29.39.4 (Tag 01VU); EGA II 4.5.10; Hartshorne II Thm 7.6

leaves.name: picLocFinType
leaves.doc: pic-dict: a scheme representing Pic_{A/K} of an abelian variety A over a field K is locally of finite type (Murre 1964 / Oort 1962, BLR, Neron models, 8.2 Thm 3: Pic_{X/k} exists and is locally of finite type for X proper over a field; also Kleiman, The Picard scheme, Thm 9.4.8 for X projective, A being projective by the vendored GrpObj.exists_isImmersion_projectiveSpace_of_smooth_of_geometricallyIntegral; any representing object by Yoneda; locators UNVERIFIED).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (BLR 8.2 Thm 3 / Murre-Oort for proper X over a field; Kleiman 9.4.8 for projective X, A projective by the vendored lemma; any representing object by Yoneda uniqueness); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: BLR, Neron models, 8.2 Thm 3 (Murre 1964, Oort 1962); Kleiman, The Picard scheme, 9.4.8

leaves.name: identityComponentLFT
leaves.doc: pic-dict: the identity component of a group scheme locally of finite type over a field is an open, geometrically irreducible subgroup (SGA 3 VI_A 2.4; Stacks 0B7R; locators UNVERIFIED).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf; locator UNVERIFIED
